posts.title: The AI papers that mattered this week — November 16, 2026
posts.description: The expensive part of an AI system is not always the model. Sometimes it is rediscovering the same file. Sometimes it is choosing the wrong experiment from a pile of promising ones. Sometimes it is waiting for a GPU while another sits idle.
